name: @muen/dsh-composer-race
description: A race light around the composer edge while the addressed agent is working. Client-only: one hidden marker inside the composer card plus one stylesheet keyed on [data-composer-card] and :has(). The two dots follow the selected theme — EVA Dark purple+green, EVA Light dark-blue+light-blue, Regular the theme's own accent — via [data-muen-race-theme] on the marker.
